name: After § 21
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Belarus, five years after the fraudulent presidential elections
part_text: 21a. Notes that several EU trade and financial sanctions have had adverse consequences, eroding the economic base of the pro-democracy middle class and benefiting people who are close to the regime; notes that the food export restrictions have had no impact on the regime’s financial resources; notes that the restrictions under the financial sanctions regime keep capital available for the Lukashenka regime, and that allowing capital outflow could reduce the regime’s financial resources; calls, therefore, for the EU to review its sanctions regime in order to limit economic hardship for the ordinary citizens of Belarus;
